one_liner: Nifty 50 surged 1.14% amid strong FII inflows and broad market gains.

drivers.title: Nifty 50 Rally
drivers.detail: Nifty 50 rose by 1.14% to close at 25,514.30.

drivers.title: FII Inflows
drivers.detail: FII net inflow was Rs 7,411.41 Cr today.

drivers.title: Auto Sector Surge
drivers.detail: Nifty Auto index jumped 4.4%, leading sector gains.

drivers.title: IT Sector Decline
drivers.detail: Nifty IT was down by 1.1%, bucking the trend.

flows_line: FII net inflow was Rs 7,411.41 Cr, while DII saw an outflow of Rs 1,356.57 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for ECB President Lagarde's speech and US consumer sentiment data tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: FII inflows can drive market rallies.
Sector performance can vary widely on the same day.
Market breadth indicates overall market health.
Global events can impact next session's market sentiment.
